briefdescription.para: OSC dispatch and basic OSC metadata handlers.

detaileddescription.para: This translation unit implements Video::applyOSC() and the basic metadata handlers: title, cwd, clipboard, desktop notification, and cursor color. Protocol-extension handlers (hyperlink OSC 8, shell integration OSC 133, iTerm2 image OSC 1337) live in VideoOSCExt.cpp. ESC-level dispatch lives in VideoESC.cpp; DCS and APC passthrough live in VideoDCS.cpp.

simplesect.title: OSC sequence structure
simplesect.para: An OSC sequence has the form: ESC]<command>;<data>BEL ESC]<command>;<data>ESC\(ST—StringTerminator) The numeric command code and data payload are accumulated in the hybrid oscBuffer and dispatched by applyOSC() when the terminator is received.

simplesect.title: Thread model
simplesect.para: All functions in this file run exclusively on the READER THREAD. Callbacks that update UI state are dispatched to the message thread via juce::MessageManager::callAsync.
Video.h — class declaration and full API documentation
VideoOSCExt.cpp — hyperlink, shell integration, iTerm2 image handlers
